# Atsumaru iOS Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a native iOS 26 client for atsu.moe with browsing, search/filter/sort, manga & novel readers, offline downloads, background auto-update, accounts, library sync, comments, forum, profiles and groups.

**Architecture:** Pure SwiftUI + `@Observable` MVVM + Repository. Single app target generated by XcodeGen with a local `Core` SPM package holding networking/models/persistence. SwiftData for local cache. Kingfisher for images, MarkdownUI for novels/forum.

**Tech Stack:** Swift 6, SwiftUI, SwiftData, Swift Testing, Kingfisher, MarkdownUI, XcodeGen, BGTaskScheduler, URLSession background sessions.

## Global Constraints

- iOS deployment target **26.0** (Liquid Glass); iPhone-only.
- Swift 6 language mode; strict concurrency (no `@unchecked Sendable` hacks; use actors/sendable value types).
- All UI uses Liquid Glass: `glassEffect`, `GlassEffectContainer`, `.glass`/`.glassProminent` button styles. Native dark-first.
- Dependencies via **SPM only**. Add via XcodeGen `project.yml` packages block.
- Cookie-session auth; session stored in Keychain (raw cookies), replayed into URLSession via `HTTPCookieStorage`.
- API base `https://atsu.moe`; all paths in `APIClient` central helper — no hardcoded URLs in views.
- Images same-origin: posters `/posters/...`, pages `/static/pages/...`; full URLs built by `ImageURLBuilder` helper only.
- File layout: `Atsumaru/` (app) + `Core/` (SPM package). Views never import `Core`'s networking internals — only `Models` and `Repositories`.
- Comments: no code comments unless a line's intent is genuinely non-obvious.
- Commits: conventional style (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `test:`), one commit per task.

---

## File Structure

**Project generation**
- `project.yml` — XcodeGen spec (app target + Core package reference + SPM packages)
- `Atsumaru/App/AtsumaruApp.swift` — `@main`, root TabView
- `Atsumaru/App/AppEnvironment.swift` — DI container (API, repositories, stores) as `@Observable`
- `Atsumaru/Info.plist` — app plist (ATS allows `atsu.moe`; NSAppTransportSecurity NSAllowsArbitraryLoads false, exception domain)
- `Atsumaru/Atsumaru.entitlements` — background modes (`fetch`, `processing`)

**Core package (`Core/Sources/`)**
- `Core/Models/*.swift` — DTOs + domain models
- `Core/Networking/APIClient.swift` — transport, cookie handling, errors
- `Core/Networking/Endpoint.swift` — typed endpoint descriptor
- `Core/Networking/Endpoints/*.swift` — route groups
- `Core/Networking/ImageURLBuilder.swift`
- `Core/Networking/SearchQuery.swift` — Typesense query builder
- `Core/Persistence/KeychainStore.swift`
- `Core/Persistence/AppDatabase.swift` — SwiftData container + models
- `Core/Repositories/*.swift` — Home, Browse, Manga, Read, Auth, User, Comments, Forum, Groups, Notifications, Downloads
- `Core/Downloads/DownloadManager.swift`
- `Core/Background/BackgroundScheduler.swift`

**App feature targets (`Atsumaru/Features/*`)**
- Home, Browse, MangaDetail, Reader (manga), Novel, Downloads, Library, Auth, Account, Comments, Forum, Community — each with `*View.swift`, `*ViewModel.swift`

**Design system (`Atsumaru/Core/DesignSystem/`)**
- `Glass.swift`, `Poster.swift`, `Theme.swift`, `Components.swift`

**Tests (`Core/Tests/`)**
- `ModelsTests`, `NetworkingTests`, `SearchQueryTests`, `DownloadManagerTests`, plus `Fixtures/` (recorded JSON)

```swift
import Foundation

public struct HomeItem: Codable, Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable {
    public let id: String
    public let title: String
    public let image: String
    public let smallImage: String
    public let mediumImage: String
    public let largeImage: String
    public let isAdult: Bool
    public let type: String
    public let medium: String
    public let mbRating: Double
    public let views: String?
    public let createdAt: Int?
    public let updatedAt: Int?

    public init(id: String, title: String, image: String, smallImage: String,
                mediumImage: String, largeImage: String, isAdult: Bool,
                type: String, medium_: String, mbRating: Double, views: String?,
                createdAt: Int?, updatedAt: Int?) {
        self.id = id
        self.title = title
        self.image = image
        self.smallImage = smallImage
        self.mediumImage = mediumImage
        self.largeImage = largeImage
        self.isAdult = isAdult
        self.type = type
        self.medium = medium_
        self.mbRating = mbRating
        self.views = views
        self.createdAt = createdAt
        self.updatedAt = updatedAt
    }

    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case id, title, image, smallImage, mediumImage, largeImage
        case isAdult, type, medium, mbRating, views, createdAt, updatedAt
    }
}

public struct HomeRail: Codable, Sendable {
    public let items: [HomeItem]
    public init(items: [HomeItem]) { self.items = items }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write APIClient + errors + endpoint**

`Core/Sources/Networking/APIClient.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

public enum ApiError: Error, Equatable {
    case invalidURL
    case http(Int)
    case server(String)
    case decoding
    case offline
}

public struct APIResponse<T: Decodable & Sendable>: Sendable {
    public let data: T
}

public final class APIClient: @unchecked Sendable {
    public static let baseURL = URL(string: "https://atsu.moe")!
    private let session: URLSession

    public init(session: URLSession = APIClient.makeSession()) {
        self.session = session
    }

    private static func makeSession() -> URLSession {
        let config = URLSessionConfiguration.default
        config.httpCookieStorage = .shared
        config.httpCookieAcceptPolicy = .always
        config.httpShouldSetCookies = true
        return URLSession(configuration: config)
    }

    public func get<T: Decodable & Sendable>(
        _ path: String, query: [String: String] = [:]
    ) async throws -> T {
        guard var components = URLComponents(url: Self.baseURL, resolvingAgainstBaseURL: false) else {
            throw ApiError.invalidURL
        }
        components.path = path
        if !query.isEmpty {
            components.queryItems = query.map { URLQueryItem(name: $0.key, value: $0.value) }
        }
        guard let url = components.url else { throw ApiError.invalidURL }
        var request = URLRequest(url: url)
        request.setValue("atsumaru-ios", forHTTPHeaderField: "User-Agent")
        request.setValue("fetch", forHTTPHeaderField: "X-Requested-With")
        let (data, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
        guard let http = response as? HTTPURLResponse else { throw ApiError.decoding }
        guard (200..<300).contains(http.statusCode) else { throw ApiError.http(http.statusCode) }
        do {
            return try JSONDecoder().decode(T.self, from: data)
        } catch {
            throw ApiError.decoding
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Write repository**

`Core/Sources/Repositories/HomeRepository.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

public protocol HomeRepository: Sendable {
    func rail(_ endpoint: HomeEndpoint) async throws -> HomeRail
}

public struct LiveHomeRepository: HomeRepository {
    private let client: APIClient
    public init(client: APIClient) { self.client = client }

    public func rail(_ endpoint: HomeEndpoint) async throws -> HomeRail {
        try await client.get(endpoint.path)
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write repository test with stub**

`Core/Tests/NetworkingTests/HomeRepositoryTests.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import Core

final class StubURLProtocol: URLProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    static var handler: ((URLRequest) throws -> (HTTPURLResponse, Data))?
    override class func canInit(with request: URLRequest) -> Bool { true }
    override class func canonicalRequest(for request: URLRequest) -> URLRequest { request }
    override func startLoading() {
        guard let handler = Self.handler else { return }
        do {
            let (resp, data) = try handler(request)
            client?.urlProtocol(self, didReceive: resp, cacheStoragePolicy: .notAllowed)
            client?.urlProtocol(self, didLoad: data)
            client?.urlProtocolDidFinishLoading(self)
        } catch {
            client?.urlProtocol(self, didFailWithError: error)
        }
    }
    override func stopLoading() {}
}

struct HomeRepositoryTests {
    @Test func railDecodes() async throws {
        let json = #"{"items":[{"id":"2VgNt","title":"Witch Hat Atelier","image":"posters/a.jpg","smallImage":"posters/a-small.avif","mediumImage":"posters/a-medium.avif","largeImage":"posters/a-large.avif","isAdult":false,"type":"Manga","medium":"Comic","mbRating":8.4,"views":"14.8M"}]}"#
        let config = URLSessionConfiguration.ephemeral
        config.protocolClasses = [StubURLProtocol.self]
        StubURLProtocol.handler = { _ in
            let resp = HTTPURLResponse(url: URL(string: "https://atsu.moe/api/home2/popular")!,
                                       statusCode: 200, httpVersion: nil, headerFields: nil)!
            return (resp, Data(json.utf8))
        }
        let client = APIClient(session: URLSession(configuration: config))
        let repo = LiveHomeRepository(client: client)
        let rail = try await repo.rail(.popular)
        #expect(rail.items.first?.title == "Witch Hat Atelier")
        #expect(rail.items.first?.id == "2VgNt")
    }
}
```

`Atsumaru/Features/Home/HomeView.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import Core

@Observable @MainActor
final class HomeViewModel {
    var rails: [(HomeEndpoint, [HomeItem])] = []
    var isLoading = false

    func load() async {
        isLoading = true
        defer { isLoading = false }
        let wanted: [HomeEndpoint] = [.popular, .trending(), .recentlyUpdated]
        var result: [(HomeEndpoint, [HomeItem])] = []
        for endpoint in wanted {
            if let rail = try? await AppEnvironment.shared.homeRepository.rail(endpoint) {
                result.append((endpoint, rail.items))
            }
        }
        rails = result
    }
}
```
(Note: `AppEnvironment.shared` static accessor + `homeRepository` are added in Step 5; `HomeEndpoint.trending()` is a helper returning `.recommended` until a dedicated trending rail is confirmed — use `.recommended` directly to avoid an undefined symbol.)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `APIClient`, `ImageURLBuilder`, `Poster`
- Produces:
  - `struct SearchQuery: Sendable { var q: String; var queryBy: [String]; var genres: [String]; var tags: [String]; var types: [String]; var statuses: [String]; var sortBy: String; var page: Int; var perPage: Int; func toQueryItems() -> [String: String] }`

  - `public protocol BrowseRepository: Sendable { func search(_ query: SearchQuery) async throws -> SearchResult; func availableFilters() async throws -> AvailableFilters }`

- [ ] **Step 2: Write query builder**

`Core/Sources/Networking/SearchQuery.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

public struct SearchQuery: Sendable {
    public var q: String = "*"
    public var queryBy: [String] = ["title", "otherNames"]
    public var genres: [String] = []
    public var tags: [String] = []
    public var types: [String] = []
    public var statuses: [String] = []
    public var sortBy: String = ""
    public var page: Int = 1
    public var perPage: Int = 30

    public init() {}

    public func toQueryItems() -> [String: String] {
        var items: [String: String] = ["q": q, "page": String(page), "per_page": String(perPage)]
        if !queryBy.isEmpty { items["query_by"] = queryBy.joined(separator: ",") }
        var filters: [String] = []
        if !genres.isEmpty { filters.append("genreIds:=[\(genres.joined(separator: ","))]") }
        if !tags.isEmpty { filters.append("tags:=[\(tags.joined(separator: ","))]") }
        if !types.isEmpty { filters.append("type:=[\(types.joined(separator: ","))]") }
        if !statuses.isEmpty { filters.append("status:=[\(statuses.joined(separator: ","))]") }
        if !filters.isEmpty { items["filter_by"] = filters.joined(separator: " && ") }
        if !sortBy.isEmpty { items["sort_by"] = sortBy }
        return items
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write repository**

`Core/Sources/Repositories/BrowseRepository.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

public protocol BrowseRepository: Sendable {
    func search(_ query: SearchQuery) async throws -> SearchResult
    func availableFilters() async throws -> AvailableFilters
}

public struct LiveBrowseRepository: BrowseRepository {
    private let client: APIClient
    public init(client: APIClient) { self.client = client }

    public func search(_ query: SearchQuery) async throws -> SearchResult {
        try await client.get("/collections/manga/documents/search", query: query.toQueryItems())
    }
    public func availableFilters() async throws -> AvailableFilters {
        try await client.get("/api/explore/availableFilters")
    }
}
```

```swift
import Testing
@testable import Core

struct SearchQueryTests {
    @Test func buildsDefaultQuery() {
        let q = SearchQuery()
        let items = q.toQueryItems()
        #expect(items["q"] == "*")
        #expect(items["query_by"] == "title,otherNames")
        #expect(items["per_page"] == "30")
    }
    @Test func buildsFilteredQuery() {
        var q = SearchQuery()
        q.genres = ["5", "6"]
        q.sortBy = "mbRating:desc"
        let items = q.toQueryItems()
        #expect(items["filter_by"] == "genreIds:=[5,6]")
        #expect(items["sort_by"] == "mbRating:desc")
    }
}
```
